name: Mysuru
description: The royal city of the Wodeyars, known for Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hill, silk, sandalwood and the Dasara festival.
description_kn: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ, ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ದಸರಾ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರಾದ ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ನಗರ.
practical_notes: Palace entry rules and timings change; check the official site before visiting.
Dasara season brings large crowds and higher prices.

name: Coorg (Kodagu)
description: Misty hills, coffee and spice plantations, waterfalls and a distinct Kodava culture, with Madikeri as the usual base.
description_kn: ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು, ಮಂಜು ಕವಿದ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜಲಪಾತಗಳ ಹಸಿರು ತಾಣ.
best_season: October to March; lush but rainy from June to September
practical_notes: Monsoon can cause landslides and road closures; check conditions before travelling.
Some activities and homestays need advance booking.

name: Hampi
description: UNESCO World Heritage site with the ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire set among boulder-strewn hills along the Tungabhadra river.
description_kn: ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಅವಶೇಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ತಾಣ.
best_season: October to February; very hot in summer
practical_notes: The site is spread out; cycles, autos or a hired vehicle help.
Wear comfortable shoes and carry water; shade is limited.
Rules about coracle rides and some areas can change; ask locally.

name: Chikkamagaluru
description: Coffee country in the Western Ghats, with Mullayanagiri, the highest peak in Karnataka, and scenic hill drives.
description_kn: ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಳ್ಳಯ್ಯನಗಿರಿಯಂತಹ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ತಾಣ.
best_season: October to February; misty and wet in monsoon
practical_notes: Some hill roads and trek areas have vehicle or entry restrictions; confirm before going.
Mornings are best for views.

name: Gokarna
description: A coastal temple town with quieter beaches than most of the coast, including Om, Kudle and Half Moon.
description_kn: ಶಾಂತ ಕಡಲತೀರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪವಿತ್ರ ಮಹಾಬಲೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಕರಾವಳಿ ಪಟ್ಟಣ.
best_season: October to March; sea is rough in monsoon
practical_notes: Swimming can be unsafe in monsoon and in some areas; follow local warnings.
The coastal trek needs daylight and sturdy footwear.

name: Jog Falls
description: One of India's highest waterfalls, formed by the Sharavathi river. Flow depends heavily on the season and dam releases.
description_kn: ಶರಾವತಿ ನದಿಯ ಭವ್ಯ ಜಲಪಾತ; ಮಳೆಗಾಲದ ನಂತರ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುಂದರ.
best_season: July to October for water flow; can be much reduced in summer
highlights: Steps down towards the base (when open)
food: Simple local meals near the entrance
practical_notes: Falls can be thin outside the rainy season; check recent conditions.
Steps and railings can be slippery in the rains.

name: Bengaluru
description: Karnataka's capital: gardens, palaces, museums, craft cafes and some of the state's best-loved breakfast eateries.
description_kn: ಉದ್ಯಾನಗಳು, ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ತಾಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಆಹಾರದ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ನಗರ.
best_season: Year-round; mild weather from October to February
practical_notes: Traffic is heavy; plan buffer time between places.
Use metro or app-based cabs for city travel.

name: Badami
description: Early Chalukya capital with rock-cut cave temples carved into red sandstone cliffs above Agastya Lake.
description_kn: ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯರ ಗುಹಾ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಂಪು ಮರಳುಗಲ್ಲಿನ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು.
best_season: October to February; hot in summer
practical_notes: Many steps and uneven rock surfaces; not ideal for limited mobility.
Midday sun is intense; plan morning or late afternoon visits.

name: Pattadakal
description: UNESCO World Heritage group of Chalukya temples showing both northern and southern Indian architectural styles.
description_kn: ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯರ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪದ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಸಮೂಹ.
practical_notes: Pairs well with Badami in one day; Aihole is a further nearby heritage stop.
Open ground with little shade.

name: Udupi
description: Temple town famous for Sri Krishna Matha and the Udupi vegetarian cuisine, close to Malpe beach.
description_kn: ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಮಠ, ಉಡುಪಿ ಖಾದ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮಲ್ಪೆ ಕಡಲತೀರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರಾದ ಪಟ್ಟಣ.
highlights: St Mary's Island (boat service is seasonal)
practical_notes: Temple dress norms apply; dress modestly.
Boat trips to St Mary's Island depend on season and sea conditions.

name: Shivamogga & Agumbe
description: Gateway to the Malnad region, close to Agumbe rainforest sunsets, Kodachadri and several waterfalls.
description_kn: ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾಗಿಲು; ಜೋಗ, ಆಗುಂಬೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಡಚಾದ್ರಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರ.
best_season: June to February; heavy rain in July and August
highlights: Base for Jog Falls and Kodachadri
practical_notes: Agumbe ghat roads are narrow and foggy in the rains.
Treks like Kodachadri may need local permissions or a vehicle booking.

name: Bandipur
description: Bandipur National Park and Tiger Reserve, a major wildlife area in the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.
description_kn: ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಡು ಸಫಾರಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರಾದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ.
best_season: October to May, with the dry months often best for sightings
food: Simple meals at resorts and nearby towns
practical_notes: Safari slots and fees vary; book through official channels.
Sightings are never guaranteed.
Vehicle movement restrictions apply on roads through the reserve at night.

name: Belur & Halebidu
description: Hoysala temples famed for intricate stone carving, including the Chennakeshava Temple at Belur and Hoysaleshwara Temple at Halebidu.
practical_notes: Belur and Halebidu are a short drive apart (about 15 km, approximate).
Temple visiting hours and dress norms apply.

name: Channapatna
description: Known as the toy town for its lacquered wooden toys, an easy craft stop between Bengaluru and Mysuru.
food: Highway eateries on the Bengaluru-Mysuru road
practical_notes: Shopping costs are extra and not included in estimates.
Good stop on the way between Bengaluru and Mysuru.
